title: MAEC-AECID Scholarships
provider: Spanish Agency for International Development Cooperation (AECID)
description: The Spanish government's main scholarship programme for foreign citizens, offered in several lines including master's study, the Diplomatic School programme and Spanish-language study, primarily for applicants from partner developing countries.
amount: Tuition, monthly stipend, travel and insurance (varies by programme line)

title: Fundacion Carolina Scholarships
field: All fields (master's, doctoral stays and postdoctoral)
description: Scholarships promoting academic and cultural cooperation between Spain and the countries of the Ibero-American Community, funding master's study, doctoral research stays and short courses at Spanish universities.
amount: Tuition, monthly stipend, airfare, insurance and accommodation support

title: la Caixa Foundation INPhINIT Doctoral Fellowships
field: STEM fields (life sciences, health, chemistry, physics, mathematics, computer science, engineering)
description: Highly competitive doctoral fellowships for early-stage researchers of any nationality to carry out a PhD at accredited research centres and universities in Spain or Portugal, with a strong training programme.
amount: Three-year employment contract with a salary starting around EUR 34,800 per year plus mobility, training and conference funds

title: la Caixa Foundation Postgraduate Fellowships (Europe)
description: Fellowships for students with Spanish or Portuguese nationality to pursue postgraduate study, some tenable at universities within the European Union including Spain. Selection is on academic and personal merit.
amount: Tuition, monthly stipend, travel and installation allowances

title: IE University International Excellence Scholarships
field: Business, law, technology, architecture, international relations, economics
description: Merit-based scholarships for international students admitted to a bachelor's or master's programme at IE University, awarded on academic record, professional achievements and the admissions assessment.

title: Universitat de Barcelona Master's Scholarships for International Students
description: Institutional scholarships and tuition reductions for international students admitted to a university master's programme at the Universitat de Barcelona, awarded on academic merit.
amount: Partial tuition reduction (varies by faculty and programme)
